title: ProvidentialScience
text:
ProvidentialScience works towards accelerating future scientific and technological advancement, creating the greatest impact possible by setting the groundwork for future innovative research, implementing solutions and methods to reconstruct the current scientific research system. Members and leaders of ProvidentialScience typically range from 11-29 years of age or are in grades 6-16 (their 4th year of university): a period of high enthusiasm, cognitive ability, and learning potential, when people are eager to identify and tackle some of the most pressing problems in science.

As of November 2023, members of ProvidentialScience have mainly been residents of China or other Asian countries, and there hasn't been significant outreach or activities in other areas of the world. Currently, ProvidentialScience is aiming to become more globalised, as scientific advancement has no borders. An official English website is also being built for this purpose; however, the process may take some time, and any website "claiming" to be our official website before 2024 is fake. For reference, these are all the reliable sources of information up to date (either managed by ProvidentialScience or its members):

Weixin Platform (only official account) - Search "providentialscience" and click the first result

Zhihu Account - https://www.zhihu.com/people/hwjagaiayshwjdhe/posts

Github (draft experimental and investigation reports will be available here for a month) - mani-celadin.github.io/MCMA/mainpage.html

Medium - https://medium.com/@providence641

We are also welcoming anyone to help expand our global outreach or to contribute to technical efforts such as website design and usage of AI. For more information, please contact providence641@gmail.com or sssofficial@sina.com.
